DiagProMeta 0.1.0
  • Reference

    Real meta-analysis of diagnostic studies: IVD data with number of subjects

    IVD.Rd

    “To identify the most accurate methods for diagnosis of IVD-related bloodstream infection.”

    IVD

    Format

    A data frame with 33 rows (studies) and 8 variables:

    study

    study ID

    TP

    True positive

    FN

    False negative

    FP

    False positive

    TN

    True negative

    cutoff.grp

    Cutoff value by group

    type

    Diagnostic type

    cutoff

    Cutoff information

    Source

    Safdar N, Fine JP, Maki DG (2005). Meta-analysis: methods for diagnosing intravascular device-related bloodstream infection. Annals of Internal Medicine, 142(6), 451–466. doi:10.7326/0003-4819-142-6-200503150-00011
